meaning: Exact native observations for seven selected helper calls in three complete collector contexts. This is a declared structural repair boundary, not rendering equivalence or a whole-helper unwrap authorization.
evidenceReaderCorrection: The initial reader checked legacy error class names only. The same captured responses were re-read using native mw-ext-cite-error. No response was re-fetched or replaced.
observedBoundary: An anonymous outer ref containing only a native note helper is not generally equivalent to the helper alone. It can create an extra note, nested call marker, list-definition error or group mismatch.
Sfn and Refn forward the supplied custom group n. Nre does not accept n and selects lower-alpha under its pinned native switch.
After unwrapping, the selected custom group requires a matching collector. A default collector alone does not satisfy n or lower-alpha.
With all matching collectors, the direct helper batch renders seven notes and seven root calls without Cite errors, including the supplied Refn/Nre text.
No-collector behavior includes native implicit collection of the default group. It is not evidence that custom groups have matching collectors.

Only an exact fresh source-bound writer proof with anonymous attribute-free outer scope, sole complete helper, supported native header/arguments and sufficient matching collectors can authorize a bounded unwrap.
Unknown/protected owners, generated-name dependencies, explicit outer attributes, competing nested content and unsupported groups retain their existing refusal boundaries.
graphSemantics: rootOrderedCalls selects calls between each fictional marker pair. orderedCalls also records nested calls inside rendered note bodies. Exact raw response and rendered HTML hashes bind both views.
